sources: history digest: revert-of-revert on MAX_BATCH_SIZE with measured gateway ceiling (R1)
history digest: config in milliseconds converted to seconds at the transport call site (commit 9b13f6e, R3)
retry cap raised with burst evidence in review R2 (explained decoy)

defects.class: value exceeds recorded limit from history (batch size above measured ceiling)
defects.description: MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 800 (line 7) is above the measured gateway ceiling of 600 records per request recorded in R1 (2000 timed out in 3 of 4 runs). Input: upload() with 1000 records. range(0, 200, 800) yields start=0, so records[0:800] is sent as one request. The gateway times out or rejects it on every attempt, the batch is parked after MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS and upload() returns 0. The author comment on line 6 says the value is within the ceiling, which the history contradicts.

defects.class: unit mismatch (seconds value in a milliseconds setting)
defects.description: UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 3 (line 14) is meant as 3 s (spec) but the field is milliseconds. client.py line 39 computes timeout_s = timeout_ms / 1000 = 0.003, passed to opener.open at client.py line 41. Input: upload() with any single record and a healthy gateway. Each attempt raises GatewayError('gateway unreachable') before the response arrives, every batch is parked, and upload() returns 0. The transport expects seconds (commit 9b13f6e), so the correct value is 3000 ms.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 10 is raised above the previous cap of 5 with the stated burst evidence (9 consecutive 503 attempts, run 14, R2). The value is consistent with the history; the retry count does not affect the batch ceiling.

timeout_ms / 1000 looks like a unit error but is the correct conversion from the millisecond config to the seconds expected by the transport (commit 9b13f6e, R3). Float division keeps sub-second precision.
The exponential expression looks unbounded, but min(MAX_BACKOFF_S, ...) caps each delay at 60 s and attempts are finite (retry_attempts), so the total retry time is bounded.

range(0, len(records) - size, size) drops the last batch: with 1000 records and size 500 only records[0:500] are sent, and with exactly 500 records nothing is sent. This is a real flaw on an unchanged line (present before the change), so a diff-mode reviewer must not report it; it is listed here only.
